eyebrow: Built for every role on the team
heading: One orchestrator. Every workflow.
description: Helix adapts to the way each member of your team ships code — so atomic work-breakdown is useful from the first commit to the last review.

items.title: Move from idea to PR without losing the thread
items.description: Describe the goal in plain language and Helix returns reviewable units — with types, tests, and a clean diff for each one.
outcomes: Skip the blank-page paralysis on big refactors
Keep personal projects on a real, auditable cadence
Ship side projects without babysitting long-running agents
items.quote: It feels like pair-programming with a teammate who actually remembers the last ten PRs.

items.title: Decompose monoliths into reviewable units
items.description: Hand Helix a sprawling initiative and get back a sequenced plan with explicit dependencies — so you can review the shape of the change before the change itself.
outcomes: See the dependency graph before any code lands
Re-run any unit deterministically with full replay
Trace every change back to the original intent
items.quote: The atomic unit of work is finally visible end-to-end.

items.title: Forecast, parallelize, and unblock with confidence
items.description: Helix surfaces what is parallelizable, what is blocked, and where reviewers should focus — turning orchestrator output into engineering signal.
outcomes: Identify blockers in real time across active runs
Tune throughput by adjusting parallelism per unit
Replace status meetings with live run telemetry
items.quote: We finally have a single pane of glass for every agent run in flight.

items.title: Translate intent into shippable increments
items.description: Write the spec the way you already do — Helix turns it into a sequenced set of small PRs you can demo at the next standup.
outcomes: Demo every increment without waiting for the whole epic
Roll back any unit without touching the rest
Keep stakeholders in the loop with shareable run URLs

items.title: Verify each unit before it merges
items.description: Every unit is checked against the rest of the repo — types, lint, tests — so flaky merges stop sneaking in through long-running agent runs.
outcomes: Block merges that break the type graph or the test suite
Replay failed units locally with the same inputs
Audit which intent produced which diff, days later

items.title: Triage contributions without burning out
items.description: Helix breaks community asks into reviewable units, so contributors can land useful work even before a maintainer is online.
outcomes: Pre-screen contributions for style and type-safety
Run contributor units against the latest main
Welcome first-time contributors with a guided flow
